name: prometiam-risk-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for the Prometiam company data and KYB API: official company-register data for 31 countries (ES, FR, GB, IE, PL, NO, FI, SE, HR, BE, DK, EE, SK, CH, LV, CY, RO, LT, CZ, DE (LEI-registered entities and energy-market register companies), US, CA, CO, BR, AR, AU, JP, IL, SG, TW, UA), plus directors and UK beneficial ownership, corporate events, monitoring, filed financial statements, insolvency notices, VAT (VIES) and LEI (GLEIF) lookup, sanctions screening (beta) and public-procurement awards, as native MCP tools for Claude, Cursor and any MCP-compatible client.
long_description:
Query official company registers from your agent. Search companies by name or by registry identifier (Spanish NIF, French SIREN or SIRET, the company number for the UK, Ireland and Poland, Norwegian organisation number, Finnish Y-tunnus, Swedish organisationsnummer, Croatian MBS or OIB, Belgian enterprise number, Danish CVR number, Estonian registry code, Swiss UID, Latvian registration number, Romanian CUI, Lithuanian juridinio asmens kodas, Canadian corporation number or Business Number, Australian ACN, ARBN or ABN, Japanese corporate number, Israeli company number, Brazilian CNPJ, Colombian NIT, Singapore UEN, Taiwanese unified business number, Czech IČO, a German LEI or register entry, or a US state registration number, CIK or LEI) and get legal form, status, incorporation date and registry coordinates back, with capital where the register publishes it.

Beyond the register itself: directors and appointments (Spain, France, the UK, Norway and Poland only; Polish natural persons are masked by the register itself) and UK beneficial ownership; corporate events (Spain, France and the UK from their official gazettes; elsewhere register-change events for name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, not gazette notices; none before 14 October 2026 for Ireland, Poland and Norway; none for Argentina) with monitoring and signed webhooks in every live country except France and Argentina; corporate insolvency notices in fifteen markets (FR, DE, GB, AT, CH, NO, FI, US, NL, DK, HR, SE, ES, LV, EE), corporate only, personal insolvency is never returned; VAT validation through VIES (27 EU states and Northern Ireland); LEI lookup, name search and ownership relationships through GLEIF; sanctions screening (beta) against the EU, UN, OFAC, UK, Australian (DFAT) and French lists and US export-control lists, refreshed daily, with an optional PEP check (beta, Spain only, national politicians only); filed annual financial statements for the UK, France, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Latvia, Estonia, Romania, Lithuania, Colombia, US SEC filers and the listed companies of Spain, Poland, Croatia, Belgium and Brazil (digitally filed accounts only; headline figures only for Estonia, Romania and Lithuania; none for French companies that declare their accounts confidential; Colombian NIIF filers only; Scale plan and above, 10 calls a month on the other plans); and public-procurement awards from Spain, France, the UK, Ireland, Poland and Norway (Ireland, Poland and Norway above the EU thresholds only), with beta public-buyer risk scores for Spain and France.

Live countries: Spain, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Poland, Norway, Finland, Sweden, Croatia, Belgium, Denmark, Estonia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Latvia, Cyprus, Romania, Lithuania, Canada, Australia, Japan, Israel, Singapore, Colombia, Taiwan, the Czech Republic, Germany, Ukraine, Brazil, Argentina and the United States. Apart from Spain, France, the UK, Norway and Poland every country is company records only, with no officers; sole traders and other natural persons are generally not served. Germany is LEI-registered entities and companies of the energy-market register, not the commercial register. The United States is one company-level record per state registration from several state business registers, plus SEC filers and LEI holders from every state, updated weekly, not every US company. Argentina is company records only, updated monthly, with no VAT number.

A free 14-day trial is available (500 credits; a card is required and nothing is charged until it ends), and the server runs in demo mode without a key (a shared demo key: 30 requests a minute and 2,000 calls a day for everyone).

api_key.description: Optional. Your Prometiam API key, starting with rk_live_ (or rk_test_). Leave it empty to use the shared demo key (30 requests a minute and 2,000 calls a day for everyone). Your own key comes with a free 14-day trial of 500 credits (a card is required, nothing is charged until the trial ends): https://www.prometiam.com/signup?utm_source=mcp
